From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightwave.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 packet — any open questions / timeline for review

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the time on today’s discovery call — it was helpful to understand BrightWave’s ingestion volumes and retention constraints. As promised I’m sharing our SOC 2 packet and a short summary sheet so your security and legal teams can review.

Attachments: [Attachment: security_packet_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)], [Attachment: SOC2_summary.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)]

Quick recap and proposed next steps:
- What we sent: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), controls mapping, and the summary spreadsheet.
- Ask from you: confirm whether your security team has everything they need for an initial pass and whether there are any specific controls you want us to call out (e.g., data segregation, key management).
- Proposed next step: 30-min follow-up with our security engineer if helpful — I can schedule for this week or next.

Can you let me know the expected review timeline and who from your side will lead the review? If timing has shifted, totally understand — a quick note of priority helps us align.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Hi Samira — just nudging this up the inbox.

I realize teams are juggling a lot; quick answers to the two items below would be super helpful so we know whether to prioritize a security deep-dive or save that time for later in the quarter:
- Do you have an estimated date for a first-pass review?
- Any immediate blockers (e.g., need additional evidence, different format, or NDA)?

If easier, I can coordinate a 20-minute call between your reviewers and Marcus (our security engineer) next week. Let me know a couple of slots that work for you.

Best,
Lauren

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 packet — any open questions / timeline for review

Hi Lauren — sorry for the delay, we’ve been coordinating internally.

Thanks for the packet — our security team is reviewing it now. A couple of notes from an initial pass:
- Legal is flagging one question around your stated data retention default and whether customer-configurable retention options are available (they asked for the specific section in the controls mapping).
- We’ve looped in our security lead (cc’d) who may want a short sync with your engineer to clarify operational details around key rotation and backups.

We should be able to provide preliminary feedback by next Wednesday (Oct 27). If you can send a one-page summary that highlights where retention and key management are documented, that’ll speed things up. Otherwise we’ll book time with Marcus.

— Samira
Director of Platform Engineering
BrightWave Analytics

Hi Samira and BrightWave Security team — great, thanks for the update and for flagging legal’s retention question.

I’ve attached a one-page retention + key management summary that points to the exact sections in the SOC 2 packet and our controls mapping. Marcus is copied and can join a short technical sync if helpful.

Attachments: [Attachment: soc2_retention_keymgmt_onepager.pdf (PDF, 75 KB)]

Suggested next steps:
- We’ll hold a 20-minute technical sync (Marcus + your security lead) to walk through key rotation cadence and backup/restoration responsibilities. Marcus, can you do Tue 10/27 at 10:00 AM PT or Wed 10/28 at 9:00 AM PT?
- Samira, if you prefer we can also surface the specific controls in a redline view for your legal team.

If anything else would unblock your review sooner please let me know. Looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
